subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT located in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dampa National Park**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dampha National Park** is situated in the Mizoram state of India, covering parts of the **Champhai** district.
 
• Established **as a national park in 1993**, Dampha National Park plays a crucial role in the conservation of biodiversity.
 
• The park experiences a subtropical highland climate, with a wet monsoon season and cool winters.
 
• It was designated as a tiger reserve under the **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) in 1994**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nameri National Park **is located in the **Sonitpur district of Assam**, bordering the Himalayan foothills and the **Nameri River.**
 
• **Kaziranga National Park** is located in the **Golaghat and Nagaon districts of Assam**, along the banks of the **Brahmaputra River**.
 
• Kaziranga is renowned for its population of the Indian one-horned rhinoceros, with about two-thirds of the world’s population residing here
 
• The park spans approximately 430 square kilometers (166 square miles) and is a** UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• **Manas National Park** is located in the foothills of the Himalayas, straddling the border between India and Bhutan in the **Baksa district of Assam**.
 
• The park covers approximately 950 square kilometers (367 square miles) and is also a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
